_about: Hand-written driver facts (State Blob White Paper V1, layer 6). Keyed by the roster's driver_id for humans and by spoken name for AI cars. 'facts' are always offerable (at most three are offered); 'armed' facts are offered only when their condition holds: on_podium, on_lead, on_win, on_retire. Keep every fact true and short; every capitalised word in a fact becomes sayable when it is offered, so no nicknames the driver would not want on air. Empty entries are fine -- this file is optional.

facts: Dustin told Sienna he's targeting third place tonight, dialing back the aggression to bring the car home clean for Autism Center OK.
He's pushing for pole in qualifying to avoid having to fight through the pack in the race.
He named Flying Pickles as the team standing between DC-Racing-Team and the Constructors' Cup.
Dustin races for Autism Center OK because family members are affected by autism, and he's sending a shout-out to Asher.
He predicted Mike would take pole position, with Cade, Mike and himself filling the podium.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna third was the target, and here he is.
armed.on_win: He told Sienna he'd settle for third, but he's brought it home in first.
armed.on_retire: He told Sienna if it went wrong early he'd pull up the stream on his big screen and cheer for the human drivers.

facts: Alex told us he expects a battle if he ends up side by side with Dustin after their contact last race.
Alex is racing for the NASCAR Foundation tonight because he thinks it's cool that it relates to cars.
Alex plans to save his tyres in qualifying and keep the car clean for consistency.
Alex predicts Mike, Cade and Dustin will take the top three spots.
Alex said if he's fourth in the final laps with charity money on the line, he'll go for it.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he'd go for it if charity money was on the line, and here he is.

facts: Shokin told us he is aiming for first place and plans to show everyone the rear view of his car all day.
He named Dustin as his main rival, saying they always compete and play enough one together.
He predicts Dustin will be too aggressive and crash into the wall.
He has been away working on other projects and is shaking off the rust after a long time out of the seat.
For the Samurai, he always eats sushi before the race as his ritual for success.

armed.on_win: He told Sienna he was aiming for first and would show everyone the rear view of his car all day, and he has done exactly that.
armed.on_retire: He told Sienna if his rival Dustin crashed he would be proven right about the aggression.

facts: Mike told us he's taking pole and the win, and he's named Dustin as the driver he expects to end up in the wall.
Mike races for Saint Jude Children's Research Hospital tonight, a cause close to his heart as a father of three daughters.
Hyde Grand Prix Engineer takes its name from Mike's Air Force call sign, honoring his military service.
Mike delivered on his exact prediction last time out: pole position and the race three win.
Mike says Dustin doesn't concern him, despite Dustin naming Mike as the man he most wants to beat.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he was taking pole and attacking from the front, and here he is.
armed.on_lead: He told Sienna he'd qualify on pole and attack right away, and he meant every word.
armed.on_win: He told Sienna he was taking pole and the win, and he's delivered exactly that.

facts: Evan told us he's coming for the win in his first league race.
He's named Kate Osterman as the driver he most wants to beat.
He's running a setup with extra downforce, leaning towards grip over speed.
He told Sienna that Evan Charley will surprise people with a top ten finish.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he was aiming for the win in his debut race, and here he is.
armed.on_win: He told Sienna he was coming for first, and he meant it.
